name: round spermatid basic protein 1 like

function.text: RSBN1L is the approved symbol for round spermatid basic protein 1 like. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in protein demethylase activity.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

selection_reason: Added to ensure complete representation of genes in the three Cancer Hotspots original release workbooks.

editorial.change_note: Initial Cancer Hotspots dictionary supplement. Pathologist review needed — LLM-generated summary/review.

function.text: RSBN1L encodes round spermatid basic protein 1 like. Its functions include protein demethylase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RSBN1L have been reported in breast carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
